_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::particle_dem#5. The random radius options clamp into [MIN_RADIUS, MAX_RADIUS] instead of redrawing, so the tails of the requested distribution collapse onto the two bounds. This is COUNTED, not inferred: the radii are read back and compared bit-exactly against the deck's own MIN_RADIUS and MAX_RADIUS, and on 4C's own lognormal deck 3 of the 4 land exactly on a bound (CLAMPED_ONTO_A_BOUND=3, ALL_STRICTLY_INSIDE=no). CLAMP_WARNINGS=0 records that 4C says nothing about clamping, truncation or bounds. Two controls: dropping RANDSEED changes the realisation, and dropping RADIUSDISTRIBUTION_SIGMA is the one case that IS refused, with its own message. The mutation widens the bounds far outside the draw, which is the honest antidote -- the clamp is a property of the bounds, not of the selector -- and then every radius is strictly inside and the count goes to zero. MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 removes the pathology from every probe deck; unmutated the fixture PASSES, mutated it FAILS. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 bash cmd.sh`. Executed 2026-08-07 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: RADIUSDISTRIBUTION_SIGMA is not set but required for a radius distribution.
